title: Downloader for TV
summary: The ultimate tool for download and manage files on your Android devices.
description:
The ultimate tool for downloading Files, Videos, Images, etc. on your Android TV, Google TV & other devices that run on Android.

Simply enter the URL that directly holds the file and press Select/Enter to download. So you can easily download it on your TV without needing a Keyboard or mouse.

You can use our free companion URLSRT.IO URL shortener and enter only the generated alias to download files. This greatly helps you save your time and effort. Downloader for TV can also be used as a mini File Manager app, as you can view the downloads under the Files section. 
Here, the downloaded files are displayed with the Name, Size, Date, and Time it was Downloaded can be seen, install an app if the downloaded file is an APK application, and delete from within the Downloader for TV app. The File download progress and file size are displayed while downloading for maximum transparency. You can find solutions for all the queries under the FAQs section within the app so that you don’t have to feel helpless while you have a query. 

Please support us and leave your feedback for more exciting features to come. 

Features:

1. Enter any file URL and download it on your TV.
2. You can use the URLSRT.IO URL shortener and enter only the generated alias to download files. 
3. Download for TV can be used as a mini File Manager app, as you can view the downloads under the Files section. Here, the downloaded files can easily view, install, and delete from within the Downloader for TV app.
4. The File download progress and file size are displayed while downloading for maximum transparency.
